description.zh: 指定修改后的资产组备注信息，最多支持500字符。
description.en: The new remarks of the asset group. The remarks can be up to 500 characters in length.

description.zh:
指定要修改的资产组ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHostGroups](~~201307~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the asset group that you want to modify.

> You can call the [ListHostGroups](~~201307~~) operation to query the ID of the host group.

description.zh: 指定修改后的资产组名称，最多支持128字符。
description.en: The new name of the asset group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.

description.zh:
指定要修改的资产组所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to modify.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
指定要修改的资产组所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host whose asset group you want to modify.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 修改资产组名称或备注信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-host-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-group-id 1 --host-group-name Group01 --comment comment --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ModifyHostGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Comment comment --HostGroupId 1 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostGroupName Group01
